name: serenity-skill
description: Supply-chain bottleneck hunter for US and A-share equity research. Combines a source-backed research workflow with Serenity's public analytical lens for AI, semiconductor, optical, memory, power, and neocloud supply chains.

interface.longDescription: Research-support plugin for mapping supply-chain scarce layers, validating evidence, ranking research priorities, and pressure-testing US and A-share investment theses through a Serenity-inspired public methodology.
defaultPrompt: Use $serenity-skill to map an AI supply chain and rank scarce layers.
Use $serenity-skill to challenge this ticker thesis with evidence.
Use $serenity-skill to build a catalyst watch for this theme.
